props.name: render
props.description: Custom render method for breadcrumb items. If omitted, defaults to standard {item.text}

props.name: separator
props.description: Separator icon or variant ('slash' | 'chevron' | 'dot' | ReactNode). Default is 'slash'

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Maximum number of items to display before collapsing middle items into a '...' dropdown menu

props.name: itemClass
props.description: Custom class name applied to non-active ancestor links

props.name: activeItemClass
props.description: Custom class name applied to the active current page item

props.name: separatorClass
props.description: Custom class name applied to separator elements
